actions.action: Separate quotation review from speaker verification
actions.mechanism: Explicit review states prevent imported labels or confidence scores from appearing as verified attribution.
actions.implementation: Default attribution to unverified. Require a recorded audio review to verify identity; allow unknown. Show attribution status in search, collections, and exports.
actions.check: Export an unresolved-speaker quote: it must say unknown and unverified, never inherit a verified badge from text review.
actions.risk: Reviewers can still misidentify voices; verification must remain reversible.

actions.action: Store corrections as attributed, immutable revisions
actions.mechanism: Stable quote references expose current corrections while preserving earlier collection and export states.
actions.implementation: Append corrections with reviewer identity and parent revision; retain imported text. Collections resolve current revisions but retain their saved revision and change history.
actions.check: Correct a saved quote’s speaker: every collection must show the correction, while its earlier attribution and reviewer remain inspectable.
actions.risk: Existing downloaded exports cannot update; their links should reveal subsequent revisions.

actions.action: Anchor quotes across segments to reviewed audio intervals
actions.mechanism: Quote-level audio anchors avoid treating potentially incorrect segment timestamps as authoritative boundaries.
actions.implementation: Represent quotes using ordered segment IDs and text ranges, plus versioned recording intervals. Provide playback handles for manual boundary correction; export audio links and offsets.
actions.check: Select a quote crossing two segments, adjust incorrect timing, then export; its audio route must play the complete selected utterance.
actions.risk: Recording access or retention failures can break otherwise valid audio routes.

actions.action: Keep uncertain speakers discoverable in search
actions.mechanism: Separate confirmed-speaker matches from provisional labels and unresolved candidates rather than silently collapsing them.
actions.implementation: Default quotation search to all speakers. Speaker filters show confirmed matches separately from imported-label matches, with an explicit option to include unresolved results.
actions.check: Search a fixture containing confirmed, mislabeled, and unknown speakers; each must appear in its appropriate group without receiving unsupported attribution.
actions.risk: Including unresolved candidates increases review effort; hiding them by default can conceal relevant quotations.
